mapper.insert: INSERT INTO upload_task (upload_id, file_name, file_size, content_type, object_key, user_uid, status, checkpoint, uploaded_parts, total_parts, is_deleted, create_time, update_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{objectKey}, #{userUid}, #{status}, #{checkpoint}, #{uploadedParts}, #{totalParts}, 0, NOW(), NOW(), #{expireTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM upload_task WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE upload_task SET checkpoint = #{checkpoint}, uploaded_parts = #{uploadedParts}, update_time = NOW() WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE upload_task SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE upload_task SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE upload_task SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE status IN (0, 1, 4) AND expire_time < NOW() AND is_deleted = 0
